title: Linear programming
text: Expressions vectorized. transportation problem 2 plants 3 markets uses 2 3 variable row column sums.
code: cost <- matrix(c(4, 6, 9,                  5, 3, 7), 2, byrow = TRUE) supply <- c(35, 50) demand <- c(20, 30, 25)  m <- opt_model() ship <- opt_variable(m, "ship", dim = c(2, 3), lower = 0) for (i in 1:2) opt_constraint(m, sum(ship[i, ]) <= supply[i], name = paste0("supply_", i)) for (j in 1:3) opt_constraint(m, sum(ship[, j]) >= demand[j], name = paste0("demand_", j)) opt_objective(m, sum(cost * ship)) r <- opt_solve(m) opt_status(r) #> [1] "optimal" opt_value(r, ship) #>      [,1] [,2] [,3] #> [1,]   20    0    5 #> [2,]    0   30   20 opt_objective_value(r) #> [1] 355

code: library(Matrix) set.seed(1) n <- 20000 k <- 2000 # every row gets at least one entry so the covering problem is feasible A <- rsparsematrix(k, n, density = 5 / n, rand.x = function(m) runif(m, 0.5, 2)) +   sparseMatrix(i = 1:k, j = sample(n, k), x = 1, dims = c(k, n)) b <- runif(k, 1, 10) cost <- runif(n, 1, 3)  m <- opt_model() x <- opt_variable(m, "x", dim = n, lower = 0) build <- system.time({   opt_constraint(m, A %*% x >= b, name = "cover")   opt_objective(m, sum(cost * x)) }) build[["elapsed"]] #> [1] 0.011 sf <- opt_standard_form(m) dim(sf$A) #> [1]  2000 20000 class(sf$A) #> [1] "dgCMatrix" #> attr(,"package") #> [1] "Matrix" r <- opt_solve(m) opt_status(r) #> [1] "optimal" r$timing #> build solve  #> 0.002 0.060 summary(opt_dual(r, "cover")) #>    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.  #>  0.0000  0.2762  0.6998  0.6937  1.0110  2.9710
